name: pm-copilot
description: A personal PM operating system that learns your context and runs morning briefs, weekly prep, open-loop reviews, and self-improvement passes.

interface.shortDescription: Context-aware planning and follow-through for product managers.
interface.longDescription: PM Co-Pilot keeps a local, user-approved memory of your role, people, priorities, decisions, and writing voice. Its skills turn connected work sources into guided morning briefs, weekly planning, open-loop reviews, memory maintenance, and system improvement.
defaultPrompt: Help me prepare for this week
